evidence.detail: send_scryfall_two_names() returns True for 'flip' layout, so the cardfeed reports flip cards as 'Erayo, Soratami Ascendant // Erayo's Essence' with legal=false (banned)
May 2022: expanded cardfeed to include flip layout in combined-name format, which may help PDBot resolve back-face names
PDBot is a separate application at pdbot.pennydreadfulmagic.com; its source code is not in this repo
No code in this repo checks flip-side legality during game observation; that logic lives in PDBot

triage.notes: Cannot determine current PDBot behavior from this repo alone. The cardfeed improvement (6206b81f) may have partially addressed the issue by exposing combined flip-card names, but whether PDBot was updated to use this is unknown. Since Erayo is banned, any 'not legal' report is factually correct; the issue may be about misleading messaging using the back-face name rather than the front-face name.
